name: The Slaughterhouse
description: (Tag:production)(Tag:resource)This rusty old key opens a door to the Slaughterhouse, whose workers supply any amount of mundane Earth-native meat on demand, breed, raise, and butcher any two live breedable animals for you at 60x efficiency, and perfectly process, pack, and return any non-living meat sent in. You may enter the universe-sized complex of soulless butchers and workers, but do not get lost or wander. WARNING: Do not send anything you do not want harvested for meat, including yourself; the workers do not care for reason.
